:-: |  :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-:
$300,$ | | $60,$ | | $12,$ | | $2.4,...$

This is the recursive formula of $300\,,\,60\,,\,12\,,\,2.4,...$.

$\begin{cases}
d(1)=300
\\\\
d(n)=d(n-1)\cdot\dfrac15
\end{cases}$
